speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to determine the cause, I will need to ask you a few questions and may request some tests.

First, how long has the bleeding been occurring, and have you experienced any pain or pressure in your pelvic area?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Carcinoma

Based on your age and the combination of postmenopausal bleeding with an adnexal mass, I am highly concerned about ovarian malignancy. To confirm this, I need to evaluate the characteristics of the mass and your hormonal status.

REQUEST TEST: CA_125, Transvaginal_Ultrasound
